metadata.description: Semicolon-separated email addresses for flow error notifications.

manual.description: Power Pages trigger — only callable from your Power Pages site. Registered in Power Pages site settings as SMKB/Flow/CreateOTP.

email.description: Email address of the user requesting an OTP.

contextId.description: [ADAPT]: rename or remove if your solution has no context identifier (e.g. eventId, requestId).

origin.description: window.location.origin from the calling client — for audit/logging.

Main_Flow.description: All main flow logic. Wrap here so Handle_Flow_Error can target this scope on unexpected technical failures. Business errors (NOT_FOUND, RATE_LIMITED, OTP_SEND_FAILED) must use Response + Terminate(Succeeded) inside this scope — they do NOT bubble up to Handle_Flow_Error.

Validate_Input.description: Guard: reject missing or obviously malformed email before touching any data. Returns 400 + Terminate(Succeeded) so Handle_Flow_Error does NOT run — invalid input is not a bug.

Respond_invalid_input.description: Return 400 for missing or malformed email.

Terminate_after_invalid_input.description: Stop the flow cleanly — no error email, no 500.

IMPLEMENT_List_Recent_OTP_Requests.description: Rate limiting: count how many OTP requests this email has sent in the last 10 minutes. [IMPLEMENT]: (1) replace entityName with your OTP table plural logical name (e.g. smkb_sol_otprequests). (2) replace smkb_sol_email in $filter with your email field name. The createdon built-in field is always available and accurate.

If_Rate_Limited.description: Block if 3 or more OTPs have been sent for this email in the last 10 minutes. 429 + Terminate(Succeeded) — no error email.

Terminate_after_rate_limit.description: Stop the flow cleanly — no error email.

IMPLEMENT_PLACEHOLDER.description:
[IMPLEMENT — BUSINESS LOGIC]: Replace this Compose action with your actual OTP generation and send actions.

What to build:
  1. Generate 6-digit OTP: use rand(100000, 999999) — never sequential or timestamp-based.
  2. Create a Dataverse OTP record: { email, otp_code, expires_at: addMinutes(utcNow(), 10), attempts: 0 }.
  3. Send OTP via SMS or email to the user.
  4. Build a 'channels' array: [{ type: 'sms'|'email_college'|'email_personal', maskedValue: '...' }].
  5. Pass channels to Respond_to_PowerPages.

Security notes:
  - Hashing the OTP is NOT required for 6-digit codes — the 5-attempt lockout in smkb_sol_CheckOtp is the primary protection.
  - On any send failure, return a business error (see pattern below) rather than letting the scope throw — send failures are expected conditions, not bugs.

CRITICAL — two error categories:

(A) BUSINESS ERRORS (NOT_FOUND, OTP_SEND_FAILED — expected, do NOT send error email):
    Pattern: Response(4xx) → Terminate(runStatus: Succeeded)
    Terminate(Succeeded) ends the run cleanly. Handle_Flow_Error does NOT run.
    Example:
      Respond_not_found  → { statusCode: 400, body: { code: 'NOT_FOUND' } }
      Terminate_not_found → { runStatus: 'Succeeded' }

(B) TECHNICAL ERRORS (Dataverse connection failure, null reference — unexpected bugs):
    Let them throw unhandled. The scope fails → Handle_Flow_Error runs → error email sent → 500 returned to caller.

Respond_to_PowerPages.description: Return OTP channels to the Power Pages caller. [IMPLEMENT]: replace body.channels with your actual channels expression, e.g. @variables('channels_array').

Handle_Flow_Error.description: Error handler — runs ONLY on unexpected technical failures (unhandled exception in Main_Flow). Business errors (NOT_FOUND, RATE_LIMITED, OTP_SEND_FAILED) use Terminate(Succeeded) inside Main_Flow and never reach here.

Check_Error_Emails_Configured.description: Only send the error email if smkb_sol_FlowErrorEmails is configured. Skipping silently when the env var is empty avoids spurious SendEmailV2 failures that would add noise to every error handler run.

Send_error_notification.description: Send error alert to all addresses in smkb_sol_FlowErrorEmails (semicolon-separated String env var).

parameters.emailMessage/Body:
@concat('

The flow smkb_sol_CreateOtp failed unexpectedly in the ', parameters('ENVIRONMENT_NAME (smkb_sol_EnvironmentName)'), ' environment.

Triggered by: ', coalesce(triggerBody()?['email'], '(unknown)'), '

Run ID: ', workflow()['run']['name'], '

Open Power Automate → Cloud flows → smkb_sol_CreateOtp → Run history to investigate.

')

Respond_with_error.description: Always return a response so the Power Pages caller does not hang. code: OTP_SEND_FAILED is what authService.ts maps to the user-facing 'could not send code' message.
